purpose: Defines the error handling policy that forbids silent fallbacks hiding internal bugs and permits catching only external-cause errors with specific exception types.
summary: Overview and scope: applies to all Python scripts and SKILL.md files
Terminology: external-cause error, internal bug, silent fallback
FR-01: catch only external-cause errors; ban bare except and except Exception; propagate internal bugs
FR-02: allowed catches for file I/O, network errors, type conversion, and HTTP server request handling
FR-03: caught errors must be reported to the caller; format defined by the script error output rules
FR-04: pure functions must not use try/except rollback; guarantee behavior with tests
Design patterns with correct and forbidden Python code examples
Decision flowchart for handling a raised exception
Table of versions and places where the policy was already applied
tasks: Writing or modifying Python scripts that handle exceptions
Reviewing code for silent fallback or broad except clauses
Writing SKILL.md instructions involving error handling
Designing error reporting in plugin scripts
Implementing pure functions such as migrations
Writing tests for error handling behavior
title: COMMON-REQ-002: エラーハンドリングポリシー要件定義書
